meta.source: Original published CarbonGlobe Ecosystem Demography (ED) reference simulations
meta.sourceType: Process-based simulation outputs, not observations or AI emulator predictions
meta.paperEvidence: Published paper pages 5–7 and Table 2 on page 24
meta.order: site-major then year; index = siteIndex * 41 + simulationYear
meta.quantization: Physical value = encoded * 0.01; all selected values are finite and nonnegative, no clipping or nodata values were introduced
meta.sampling: Every fourth row and column of original 0.5-degree mask; 3,373 original cells at 2-degree spacing where available, no spatial interpolation or averaging
meta.annualSelection: December record (month index 11) of each target year 0–40; year 0 is the initial state and years 1–40 are successive reference states
meta.coordinates: C-order nonzero mask cells; latitude = 89.75 - row * 0.5; longitude = -179.75 + column * 0.5
meta.coordinateValidation: Latitude and compressed source order match every supplied training/test latitude; longitude follows inferred standard west-to-east cell centers, corroborated by geographic land overlap
meta.profileSelection: Nearest original land cells to three illustrative anchors; these are single-cell examples, not regional means or in-situ stations
meta.profilePrecision: Six decimals for states; three decimals for annual forcing summaries
meta.initialAgeMeaning: Separate ED simulations initialized at different forest ages. These do not provide individual-tree ages, detailed ED cohort structure, tree positions, or measured tree geometry
meta.seasonality: December LAI is a seasonal snapshot; small northern winter values must not be interpreted as year-round canopy density

climate.source: Raw physical values in glob_X_fea.npy, shared environmental forcing across initial-age simulations
climate.mappingEvidence: Paper Table 2 ordering/counts and upstream preprocessing shapeCLM/shapeCO2; raw numerical blocks agree with their physical units
climate.temperatureC: Arithmetic mean of 12 monthly mean air temperatures, converted from K by subtracting 273.15; months have equal weight
climate.precipitationMm: Sum of 12 monthly precipitation totals, in mm
climate.co2Ppm: Arithmetic mean over 12 months and 24 hourly-average CO2 features, in ppm; months and hours have equal weight
climate.yearAlignment: Forcing array indices 0–39 are labeled transition years 1–40; there is no exported forcing year 0
climate.calendar: Simulation indices only; the paper describes a historical 1981–2021 experiment. No independently verified calendar alignment is asserted for these forcing summaries
climate.interpretation: Drivers provide context for the paired simulation, not causal attribution, isolated climate responses, observations, or future/counterfactual scenario results

meta.scope: Original published dataset only; no SSP126/585, competition scenarios, fitted emulator results, or generated future trajectories
meta.animation: A conceptual forest illustration may interpolate between annual states for display. Its tree geometry, continuous motion, global point sizes, and neural-network graphics are illustrative; they are not additional scientific outputs

selectedValueHashes.selection: [profileSourceIndices, all 40 forcing years, all 12 months, features [0,1,8:32]]

meta.selectedHashEncoding: SHA-256 of selected raw float32 values in little-endian C order, before rounding or quantization; avoids reading entire multi-GB source files
